\begin{example} \end{example}[$\mathbb {RP}^n$ admits no immersion into $S^n$]

Source: petersen:page-0217 ↗ thm:pet-ch5-monodromy-theorem 1. ch5:5.6.10$M=\mathbb {RP}^n=(\mathbb R^n-\{ 0\} )/(\text{antipodal map})$ is not simply connected, hence admits no immersion into $S^n$ realizing the monodromy construction. \end{example}
